punctuation.ocr: When a Circumcision takes place , the following is said — Remember the covenant of Abraham , and the binding of Isaac on the altar , and bring back the captives of the tents of Jacob , and save us for the sake of thy name . It is a sign of covenant between me and thee , our Father , who but we still bear this seal on his flesh ? ' Thou hast entered into this covenant with us : and O turn with compassion towards the remnant of Israel , and save us for the sake of thy name . Remember thy mercy , and let the red sin become white as snow ; look on the covenant , and redeem thy children , anticipate the prayer of Jacob , the pious man , and remember the congregation which thou hast purchased of old .
